text:
Tara: kicking off Pinemist private VPC onboarding checklist. Need short answers on network egress, KMS type, log sink format, and any renewal flags (renewal in ~19 days). keeping this thread as single source for runbook updates.

Jorge: peering established from our side. blocked by their managed NAT: it SNATs traffic into 172.31.0.0/16 which masks the source CIDR we expect for mgmt. they need a static route or exclude our mgmt-range from SNAT.

Jorge: in their cloud UI they can add a route: 
```
Destination: 10.60.0.0/16 -> NextHop: vpn-gw-pinemist
```
Or add a no-snat rule for source 10.60.0.0/16 -> pine-mgmt.

Samir: KMS: customer prefers HSM-protected key (CloudKMS HSM). ask: do they need attestations published to their compliance team? if yes we'll need time for paperwork + RA. For cutover, recommended approach: use customer-managed key (HSM) but set rotation to manual until cutover completes.

Samir: minimal IAM to grant now:
- grantee: serviceAccount:redwood-inference@prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
- resource: projects/pinemist/locations/global/keyRings/pm-kr/cryptoKeys/pm-llm
(please share full resource name so we can bind now)

Leah-AE: renewal note: usage sits at ~12% of committed capacity last 30d, plus only 1 seat active. I'll ask for a quick health check call. propose we offer a 14-day Dedicated trial extension if they meet 3 cutover items (routes, key binding, logs green). ok?

OpsSara: logs: their SIEM accepts JSON-lines over HTTPS but drops connection on keepalive < 15s. also important: they only accept gzip compressed payloads >1MB. set batch size ~400 events and gzip on client side. Example header we used successfully: 
```
Content-Encoding: gzip
Content-Type: application/x-ndjson
```
Also verify certificate chain; they block certs without intermediate CA.

Jorge: firewall / security group summary from our side:
- allow outbound 443 -> logs.pinemist-siem.example:443
- allow inbound 2200 from their ops-bastion for ssh-support
- allow TCP 12000 for KV streaming from 10.60.0.0/16 -> our backend pool
- deny all other inbound except health probes (TCP 8081 from monitoring ip)

Tara: can you paste the exact SG/ACL rule objects (json/yaml) so I can add to runbook?

Jorge: posting example SG (cloud provider):
```
- name: redwood-pinelist
  rules:
    - direction: egress
      protocol: tcp
      port: 443
      dest: logs.pinemist-siem.example/32
    - direction: ingress
      protocol: tcp
      port: 2200
      source: ops-bastion/32
    - direction: ingress
      protocol: tcp
      port_range: 12000-12000
      source: 10.60.0.0/16
```

Samir: also to confirm: rotation policy set to manual -> please confirm once you create the key resource so we can attach SA. if they cannot provide HSM attestation in time, we support managed key fallback for cutover with documented re-key plan.

Leah-AE: fine with conditional fallback. i'll message account contact and schedule a health sync tomorrow 10:00 PT.

InfraBot: Ticket CS-4999 created: "Pinemist VPC onboarding - routes/KMS/logging" assigned to Jorge, Samir. Due: 48h.

OpsSara: quick smoke test curl for their endpoint (use TLS1.2+ and gzip):
```
cat sample.json | gzip | curl -v --data-binary @- -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" -H "Content-Type: application/x-ndjson" https://logs.pinemist-siem.example/ingest
```
I will run this after Jorge confirms egress.

Tara: risk summary: renewal low risk if cutover progress shown; medium risk if we don't hit runbook items in 7 days. action owners: Jorge (network rules + runbook snippets) due EOD today, Samir (KMS bind + rotation policy confirm) due tomorrow, Leah (AE health call scheduled) due tomorrow morning, OpsSara (log smoke) due after egress confirmed.

Samir: one compliance FYI: they asked about key escrow for HSM keys. we support escrow but need legal NDA & SOW amendment. that'll add ~2 weeks. will flag in ticket.

Tara: excellent. i'll update runbook + send invites. please drop short status updates here only. thanks! :raised_hands:
